notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Improved jump detection.
Attacking with a dagger or sword now automatically aims at closest enemy.
Option to turn off auto-aim.
Lowered some build requirements.
Increased items given from enemies.
Increased dagger damage.
Some bug fixes.
